rule: Every fix that was ever in a pack is in every later pack. A fix leaves only by moving it to 'retired' with a written reason. build_pack.py refuses to build otherwise, and also refuses when the install has a changed file that is neither shipped nor listed under 'not_shipped' with a reason.
how_to_add_a_fix: 1) add the patch to PATCHES in apply_hotfix.py, 2) add it under 'shipped', 3) bump ZIP_NAME in build_pack.py and add the new version under 'packs' with every shipped file, 4) add a line to CHANGELOG.md.
